items.description: A URL origin such as "http://127.0.0.1:4010" (scheme://host[:port], no path), or an environment token such as "${MOCKBANK_ORIGIN}" that the loader expands before use.

origins.description: Exact origins the system may act on. ${ENV} tokens are expanded by the loader, not by the schema. Anything else is denied.

origin.description: The allowed origin this rule applies to; must be listed in allow.origins.

items.description: A path glob relative to an origin, starting with "/": "*" matches within one segment, "**" across segments, e.g. "/member/**". No whitespace, no host.

include.description: Globs of routes the system may visit on this origin.

items.description: A path glob relative to an origin, starting with "/": "*" matches within one segment, "**" across segments, e.g. "/member/**". No whitespace, no host.

exclude.description: Globs that are denied even when included, e.g. "/__admin/**". Required (may be empty) so a denial is always explicit.

items.description: Route allowlist for one origin. A route is allowed when it matches an include glob and no exclude glob.
The kind of action a step performs. Discriminates the Step union.

actions.description: Action kinds that may run at all. An action kind not listed is denied.

allow.description: The allowlist (R6.1): origins, routes and action kinds.

items.description: Regex source matched against the target control name.

controlNamePatterns.description: Controls whose accessible name matches are irreversible (e.g. Confirm, Submit), whatever the declared risk.

items.description: A path glob relative to an origin, starting with "/": "*" matches within one segment, "**" across segments, e.g. "/member/**". No whitespace, no host.

routes.description: Routes on which any screen-changing action is irreversible, e.g. "/subaccount/confirm".

irreversible.description: How the policy recognises irreversible actions. Risk is only ever raised by these, never lowered.

regex.description: ECMAScript regex source of values to mask (the redactor adds the "g" flag). Must not match "".

mask.description: full: replace the whole match. keep_last_2 / keep_last_4: mask all but the last 2 / 4 characters.

items.description: A redaction rule for a class of sensitive values (SSN-like, account-number-like, member-number-like).

terms.description: Literal terms to mask wherever they appear, e.g. the synthetic member names of the mock bank.

redaction.description: Redaction rules applied before any sink (invariant 3), in addition to known sensitive values.

expiresMs.description: How long an approval request stays answerable, in milliseconds (at most 24 h).

description: The action policy (R6): what the system may touch, which actions are irreversible, and what must be redacted. Every agent, replay and human action is checked against it (invariant 2).
